title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.39372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. translated_title: Cord：面向掩码扩散语言模型的置信度锚定顺序残差解码
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的解码顺序会显著影响生成质量，然而常见的解码器通常在整个生成过程中采用相同的揭示规则。置信度提供了一个强大的默认策略，但它衡量的是当前位置此刻被预测的确定程度，而非揭示该位置对后续解码的有用程度。我们提出Cord，一种轻量级的基于提示条件化的策略，它将置信度解码保留为稳定的参考，并通过生成方向、与已揭示上下文的接近程度以及双向填充等几何残差来学习何时以及如何偏离该参考。这些残差能够同时适应提示和不断演化的部分响应。Cord不是在每个解码步骤都采样新的策略动作，而是在每次展开中仅采样一个低维系数矩阵，该矩阵会诱导出一条完整的依赖于状态的揭示轨迹。由此得到一个上下文老虎机形式的训练方法……
tldr: Cord提出了一种轻量级的提示条件化策略，以置信度解码为稳定锚点，通过每次展开仅采样一个低维系数矩阵来诱导几何残差自适应地调整掩码扩散语言模型的揭示顺序，从而提升生成质量。
en_tdlr: Cord is a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that anchors on confidence decoding and samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout to induce adaptive geometric residual adjustments to the reveal order of masked diffusion language models, improving generation quality.
